scope: generated harmonic matrices, independent Lyapunov references and finite native trajectories only
units: atomic: bohr, hartree, electron mass, atomic time; beta in inverse hartree

hardware.cpu_description: AMD EPYC 9V74 80-Core Processor; session cgroup quota 8 vCPU, memory 8 GiB (verified separately)
hardware.allocated_vcpus: not probed; os.cpu_count is not an allocation guarantee

parameters.provenance: PyRPMD generated piglet-fit positive-arrowhead-harmonic-relaxation-v2; no third-party matrix data

parameter_metadata.objective: relative harmonic potential and centroid-virial kinetic energy error plus internal harmonic relaxation penalty
parameter_metadata.covariance_normalization: dimensionless: divide mass-scaled covariance by P/beta
parameter_metadata.scope: harmonic moments on the declared band; no anharmonic, timestep, sampling or NPT convergence claim

relaxation_controls.origin: fixed PyRPMD fitting controls, not a published PIGLET parameter prescription
relaxation_controls.free_bath_initial_covariance: block_diag(0,C): q=0; bath at its stationary free-particle covariance; no q-bath correlations
relaxation_controls.cold_initial_covariance: zero covariance of all q,p,s variables
relaxation_controls.scope: internal harmonic modes only; not arbitrary initial laws, the centroid, or anharmonic systems

validation.diffusion_convention: D = A C + C A.T; B B.T = D

piglet.initialization: q=0; native joint free-bath momentum/auxiliary draw
piglet.uncertainty: maximum of independent-atom standard error and time-block standard error

canonical_pimd.uncertainty: maximum of independent-atom standard error and time-block standard error
